name: Spirit Speaker (Geomancer Archetype)
body:
Some geomancers learn methods to gain smaller boons from spirits rather than driving them out. These geomancers are called spirit speakers.

Spirit Hex (Su/Sp)

At 2nd level and 4 levels thereafter, a spirit speaker learns a hex available to a shaman. Additionally, they gain one changeable hex they choose when communing with the spirits. They only get one hex of this kind but it can be chosen from the shaman spirit notated for the spirit communed with as follows:

Earth-stone
Fire-flames
Metal-battle
Water-waves
Wood-wood

This ability replaces rebuke spirits.
